newsitem.title: AZERBAIJAN: Ukraine to sell Azerbaijan 100,000 T grain - agency.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to sell Azerbaijan 100,000 T grain - agency.

text.p: Ukraine plans to sell the former Soviet republic of Azerbaijan up to 100,000 tonnes of wheat over 12 months, with half to be delivered in 1996, Azerbaijan's Assa-Irada news agency quoted an official as saying.

It quoted the Ukrainian ambassador in the Azeri capital Baku, Boris Aleksenko, as saying Ukraine's Interagrotek had signed a contract for the deal with Azerbaijani state firm Khleboprodukty. Aleksenko valued the contract at around $20 million, but gave no further details.
Itar-Tass news agency estimated Azerbaijan's 1996 net grain output at around one million tonnes this year, but total annual domestic demand is seen at around 1.7 million tonnes.

Ukraine is facing a very poor net harvest of 26 million tonnes this year, far below last year's 36 million tonnes, but has said it still plans to export about three million tonnes, mostly winter wheat, from this year's crop. --Moscow Newsroom, +7095 941 8520
